name: Dream Odyssey
summary:
You wake up in your bedroom, at the edge of dreams and reality, everything is familiar yet unknown. You play as Billy, a young boy fascinated by astronomy who must help his favorite toy, Bubbles, to get back on his planet.
Interact with the environment to help him reach his spaceship.
Enter the adventure, use your knowledge and the power of the Astro gloves to resolve the puzzles !

This is an early version of the game, it does not represent the final product.

Available languages : French
